properties.displayName: Authentication ASIM filtering parser for Wiz Cloud
properties.query:
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Source: WizAuditlogsV3_CL (The Wiz Connector specifies WizAuditLogsV3_CL instead,
// but is pushing to a table with a lower "l")
// Only the "Login" and "TokenRefresh" audit actions are authentication-relevant.
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
let parser = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null),
    endtime: datetime = datetime(null),
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    srchostname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    username_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    targetappname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    eventtype_in: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    eventresult: string = '*',
    eventresultdetails_in: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    disabled: bool = false,
    pack: bool = false
) {
    // srchostname_has_any, targetappname_has_any, eventresultdetails_in are accepted for
    // compatibility with the imAuthentication unifying parser's documented parameter set,
    // but are not functional. This source has no SrcHostname data, TargetAppName is always the
    // constant "Wiz", and EventResultDetails is always empty.
    let AuthActions = dynamic(["Login", "TokenRefresh"]);
    WizAuditlogsV3_CL
        | where not(disabled)
        | where (isnull(starttime) or timestamp >= starttime)
                and (isnull(endtime) or timestamp <= endtime)
        | where (array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or "Logon" in (eventtype_in))
        | where action in (AuthActions)
        | where (eventresult == '*' or (eventresult == "Success" and status == "SUCCESS") or (eventresult == "Failure" and status == "FAILED"))
        | where (array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or sourceIP has_any (srcipaddr_has_any_prefix))
        | extend
            _UserName = tostring(user.name),
            _UserId = tostring(user.id),
            _SaName = tostring(serviceAccount.name),
            _SaId = tostring(serviceAccount.id),
            _Email = tostring(user.email)
        | extend _TargetUsername = iff(isnotempty(_UserName), _UserName, _SaName)
        | where (array_length(username_has_any) == 0 or _TargetUsername has_any (username_has_any))
        | extend
            _IsServiceAccount = isempty(_UserName) and isnotempty(_SaName),
            TargetUsername = iff(isnotempty(_UserName), _UserName, _SaName),
            TargetUserId = iff(isnotempty(_UserName), _UserId, _SaId)
        | extend
            TargetUsernameType = iff(isempty(TargetUsername), "", iff(TargetUsername has "@", "UPN", "Simple")),
            TargetUserType = iff(isnotempty(_UserName), "Regular", iff(isnotempty(_SaName), "Service", "")),
            TargetUserIdType = iff(isempty(TargetUserId), "", "Other"),
            EventResult = case(status == "SUCCESS", "Success", status == "FAILED", "Failure", "NA"),
            EventSeverity = iff(status == "FAILED", "Low", "Informational"),
            EventSubType = iff(_IsServiceAccount, "Service", "Interactive")
        | extend
            LogonMethod = iff(_IsServiceAccount, "Service Principal", "Other")
        | extend
            AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack("TenantId", TenantId, "UserEmail", _Email), dynamic(null))
        | project
            EventCount = int(1),
            EventProduct = "Cloud",
            EventVendor = "Wiz",
            EventSchema = "Authentication",
            EventSchemaVersion = "0.1.4",
            EventStartTime = timestamp,
            EventEndTime = timestamp,
            EventType = "Logon",
            EventSubType,
            EventResult,
            EventResultDetails = "", // Isn't logged at the source
            EventSeverity,
            EventOriginalUid = auditlogId,
            EventOriginalType = action,
            EventOriginalResultDetails = status,
            EventUid = _ItemId,
            LogonMethod,
            LogonTarget = "Wiz",
            Dvc = "Wiz",
            DvcHostname = "Wiz",
            TargetAppName = "Wiz",
            TargetAppType = "SaaS application",
            TargetUsername,
            TargetUserId,
            TargetUsernameType,
            TargetUserType,
            TargetUserIdType,
            SrcIpAddr = sourceIP,
            Src = sourceIP,
            HttpUserAgent = userAgent,
            User = TargetUsername,
            Dst = "Wiz",
            Application = "Wiz",
            IpAddr = sourceIP,
            AdditionalFields,
            TimeGenerated,
            Type
};
parser(
    starttime=starttime,
    endtime=endtime,
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix=srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    srchostname_has_any=srchostname_has_any,
    username_has_any=username_has_any,
    targetappname_has_any=targetappname_has_any,
    eventtype_in=eventtype_in,
    eventresult=eventresult,
    eventresultdetails_in=eventresultdetails_in,
    disabled=disabled,
    pack=pack
)
